decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding Condition 2 electrical engineers layout drawing 3838/W/E/1212 REV P1 (entitled "Wallis House Fa?ade Lighting Layout Planning Application" and dated Nov 07) is not hereby approved.  Electrical engineers layout drawing 3838/W/E/1212 REV P1 shall be amended to show nine lights to each of the building's wings so as to accord with the approved detail and the amended drawing shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority as a record and the relevant electrical work carried out in accordance with the same.
description: Installation of external lighting to the Listed Wallis House Building
